mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the 12-month change in CPI exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL 12m change exceeds 3.0%, or the Rank IC is negative over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in payroll employment signals strong labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: High consumer confidence (RSAFS > 400,000) combined with strong housing starts (HOUST > 900) signals robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS > 400000 and HOUST > 900, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 signals a contraction in manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0, or the Rank IC is negative over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly decline in real GDP (GDPC1) relative to the previous quarter signals an economic slowdown, which increases risk aversion and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 declines quarter-over-quarter, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 7.5%, it signals labor market weakness, which reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 7.5, or the Rank IC is negative over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 850 thousand units signals a weakening housing market, which is a leading indicator of reduced consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 850, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.
